name: How much does it cost to widen a hallway in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to widen a hallway in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to widen a hallway in the Bay Area varies significantly based on factors like the length of the hallway, whether walls are load-bearing, the extent of electrical or plumbing rerouting, and finishes chosen. Simple modifications might start in the low thousands, while more complex projects involving structural changes or extensive utility work could range from several thousand to tens of thousands of dollars. A detailed estimate requires an on-site evaluation by a qualified contractor.
